goals: Preserve mozkomor's Double Barrel 1.0.1 behavior in the Fabric port for Minecraft Java 26.2.

Retain vanilla barrel identity while providing the upstream paired-barrel storage, placement, persistence, rendering, automation, comparator, and removal behavior without intentional gameplay changes.
scope: Maintain the vanilla minecraft:barrel extension, serialized double_barrel connection states, absolute partner position, and main-half ownership semantics.

Maintain supported and forbidden pairing orientations, one shared 54-slot view over two 27-slot barrel inventories, the vanilla six-row menu, hopper and comparator exposure, save/reload behavior, and removed-half-only drops.
Maintain the connected barrel models, textures, blockstate override, and Canary 2 Minecraft 26.2 BlockEntity removal-hook correction.

exclusions: New porting work, redesign, feature additions, configuration, or intentional gameplay changes.
Custom blocks, items, block entities, menus, screens, networking, recipes, loot tables, or tags beyond the preserved upstream architecture.
Matcha-specific resource-pack work, speculative compatibility patches, and the separate Stack to Nearby Chests shutdown defect.
Unreported full-matrix, dedicated-server, or multiplayer validation.
Runtime deployment, either Test Slot, the physical Workbench, and the protected gameplay instance during this migration.
